source.name: SportsPro: Atletico Madrid net '€40m per season' Riyadh Air shirt sponsorship
source.quote: 2Playbook reports the deal is worth €40 million (US$43.9 million) per season and will run through the 2026/27 campaign
source.note: SportsPro also states Riyadh Air's logo debuted on Atlético's kits in the 2023/24 LaLiga opener against Granada on 14 August 2023.

note: Reported €40m per season (2Playbook via SportsPro), front of shirt from the 2023/24 season through 2026/27. A previous version of this record said from 2025-26 until 2034-35 (dated 2025-04); no openable source for those dates was found, so the record now follows its cited source. Separate naming-rights deal: Riyadh Air Metropolitano, announced October 2024, runs to 2033 (see atletico-de-madrid-riyadh-air-stadium).
